_readme: Proponent-site watchlist for watch-new-filings.yml. Each entry: a page the lane fetches on schedule; any NEW link ending .pdf (or matching link_pattern) is waybacked and queued. Generic differ - no per-site scrapers. Add entries as new Ontario EAs appear on ERO; the notice usually names the proponent project page. Failures are reported in the lane log, not silently skipped.
